title: Maintaining Drain Performance: The Science of Pipe Slope
description: Correct pipe pitch in horizontal drainage lines is essential for long-term reliability. If a waste pipe is installed with excessive slope, liquid flows too quickly, leaving solid materials behind to dry and form stubborn clogs. Conversely, inadequate slope creates low scouring velocity, resulting in standing water and gradual buildup of grease and debris. Proper grade ensures liquids and solids travel together efficiently. Always verify minimum slope requirements with local plumbing codes based on pipe diameter.
caption:
Maintaining Drain Performance: The Science of Pipe Slope

Correct pipe pitch in horizontal drainage lines is essential for long-term reliability. If a waste pipe is installed with excessive slope, liquid flows too quickly, leaving solid materials behind to dry and form stubborn clogs. Conversely, inadequate slope creates low scouring velocity, resulting in standing water and gradual buildup of grease and debris. Proper grade ensures liquids and solids travel together efficiently. Always verify minimum slope requirements with local plumbing codes based on pipe diameter.
